arguments.sql:
SELECT c.frameVersion,
       COUNT(*) AS artist_card_count,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN c.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
                       AND c.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS both_ids_count,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN c.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
                       AND c.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
                       AND (TRIM(c.cardKingdomId) = '' OR TRIM(c.cardKingdomFoilId) = '') THEN 1 END) AS blank_id_count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.artist = 'John Avon'
GROUP BY c.frameVersion
ORDER BY c.frameVersion

arguments.sql:
WITH frame_counts AS (
    SELECT c.frameVersion AS frame_year, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM cards AS c
    WHERE c.artist = 'John Avon'
      AND c.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
      AND c.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
      AND c.frameVersion GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
    GROUP BY c.frameVersion
)
SELECT frame_year, card_count
FROM frame_counts
WHERE frame_year = (SELECT MAX(frame_year) FROM frame_counts)
LIMIT 1000
